block.ee_rectifier.three_phase_rectifier: Three phases in, direct current out. A bridge of six diodes inside.
Copper terminals: phases 1-3, red: +, blue: -. No neutral needed.
block.ee_rectifier.single_phase_rectifie: Phase and neutral in, direct current out. A bridge of four diodes inside.
Copper terminals: phase and neutral (either way), red: +, blue: -. Add a capacitor on the output for smooth current.
